name: react-content-rollup
title: Content Rollup
shortDescription: A reliable, low-config content rollup web part: roll up recent news from a list, or across sites via a Microsoft Search (KQL) query, with no CAML or Handlebars setup.
longDescription: A dependency-light content rollup web part that surfaces recent news and content from across SharePoint sites. Point it at a list (for example, News) for curated, dependable results, or leave the list empty to fall back to a tenant-wide Microsoft Search (KQL) query. It needs no CAML or Handlebars configuration and handles tenants where search is restricted by letting you use a list instead, so it keeps working where older content-query web parts break.
